trendFollowing.title: Trend Following
trendFollowing.desc: Uses Moving Average (20, 50, 200), MACD and ADX to identify strong trends. Enters positions in trend direction with stop loss below/above nearest support/resistance.

rangeTrading.title: Range Trading
rangeTrading.desc: When market is sideways, EA uses Bollinger Bands and RSI to trade within range. Buys at support, sells at resistance with minimum RR of 1:1.5.

marketCondition.title: Market Condition Filter
marketCondition.desc: Analyzes volatility (ATR), current spread and trading time. Automatically pauses during unfavorable conditions (high spread, low volatility).

riskManagement.title: Risk Management
riskManagement.desc: Fixed 1-2% risk per trade, position sizing based on volatility. Stop loss always set beforehand, trailing stop when profit > 1.5R.

timeNews.title: Time & News Filter
timeNews.desc: Only trades during high liquidity hours (London + NY session). Automatically closes positions before major news (NFP, FOMC, CPI).

adaptive.title: Adaptive Parameters
adaptive.desc: EA parameters auto-adjust to market volatility. Stop loss and take profit calculated dynamically based on ATR.

items.question: Which brokers does the EA work on?
items.answer: EA ThebenchmarkTrader works on most brokers supporting MT4/MT5. However, best performance is on brokers with low spreads, fast execution (ECN/STP), and no EA strategy restrictions.

items.question: Will I receive commissions if I sign up through the link?
items.answer: We may have IB/affiliate programs with some brokers. However, this does not affect your spread or trading conditions. You can always register directly if you prefer.

items.question: Which broker is best suited for this EA?
items.answer: If prioritizing strong regulation: Tickmill (FCA) or ThinkMarkets (FCA/ASIC). If small capital or beginner: PuPrime ($50 minimum). If heavy scalping: Tickmill (0.0 spread, good execution).

items.question: Do I need a VPS?
items.answer: VPS is recommended for EA to run 24/7 stably. ThinkMarkets and some other brokers provide free VPS with certain deposit/volume conditions. You can also rent your own VPS.
